content.short: SimpleSwap is a non-custodial anonymous crypto exchange with 1000+ cryptos onboard.
content.description: SimpleSwap provides a straightforward, dependable crypto exchange experience focused on privacy and ease of use. Users can perform anonymous swaps in just a few steps, making cross-chain trading practical and fast. The platform supports a broad range of cryptocurrencies and multiple networks, enabling buy, sell, and swap actions across different ecosystems with low fees. Whether converting assets on Ethereum, Solana, Arbitrum, ZKsync, or other chains, SimpleSwap aims for fast settlement and transparent pricing, helping you move funds securely and efficiently.
